scope: bounded local native protected-mode segment access and selected regressions

observations.paired_rep_movsb_partial_fault_retry: Both engines enter the authored #GP handler after copying AB with ECX=2, ESI=0x10000 and EDI=0x2002; handler widens DS and retries to ABCD.
paired_scalar_limit: Both engines fault before a dword read beginning at DS:0x10000, then repair and retry.
Both engines fault before a dword read beginning at DS:0xFFFE whose final bytes cross the 0xFFFF limit, then repair and retry.
observations.qemu_only_cold_restore: At the first REP #GP handler after AB, QEMU saved, closed and restored into a fresh process, retained the frame and partial state, then retried once to ABCD.
observations.lock_cmpxchg_reference_difference: QEMU faults before the atomic update and retries after repair. DOSBox-X reaches completion with DS=0x20, no handler marker, EAX=0x13579BDF and memory replaced with 0x2468ACE0.
observations.null_ds_reference_difference: QEMU faults on null DS and retries after repair. DOSBox-X reaches completion with DS=0, no handler marker and a read from the null-based address rather than the authored buffer value.
